name: Gasthof Dorferwirt
beschreibung:
Overview

The Landgasthof Dorferwirt is located in the Oberau district of the Wildschönau, a high valley in the heart of the Kitzbühel Alps in Tyrol. The house is classified as a 3-star inn and is run by the Schoner family as a family business. Oberau lies at an altitude of around 880 metres, surrounded by the mountain scenery of Tyrol. Guests can look forward to a blend of tradition and regional enjoyment: a cosy restaurant, a rustic snug, a fireplace lounge and a sun terrace with a view of the Wildschönau mountains. As a gourmet inn, the house focuses on regional and home-produced products; many ingredients come from its own farm and alpine pasture. Guests stay in rooms with a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi and mostly a balcony. The offer includes a breakfast buffet and the Wildschönau Premium Card.

History/Background

The walls of the Dorferwirt are traditional and steeped in history: the hereditary farm has been in the hands of the Schoner family since 1685. Hostess Erika personally cooks for the guests and spoils them with traditional Tyrolean dishes as well as international specialities. The menu features classics such as Wildschönau turnip dishes, beef goulash, onion roast beef, pike-perch fillet and homemade Kaiserschmarrn. As a partner of the „Bewusst Tirol“ initiative, the business focuses on sustainability and regional products and is part of the Culinary Dragon Trails within the framework of the TAL Herbst Wildschönau.

Getting there

Landgasthof Dorferwirt is located at the address Dorf, Oberau 26, 6311 Wildschönau in Tyrol. The house has its own car parking spaces. Check-in is possible from around 12:30 to 19:00, check-out is at 10:00. The Wildschönau is home to the four mountain villages of Oberau, Niederau, Auffach and Thierbach, which are starting points for activities in nature in every season.

Tips

The cuisine is advertised as traditional, regional cuisine with home-style cooking and vegetarian dishes; a choice of menu is available, half board on request. The hot food is served from 11:30 to 14:00 and from 17:30 to 21:00; the house's opening hours depend on the summer and winter season. Free Wi-Fi, a generous breakfast buffet and the Wildschönau Premium Card are part of the stay. For those seeking peace and quiet as well as for active holidaymakers, the house is regarded as a personal, family starting point for the region.

Best time to travel

The business is open seasonally: the summer season runs from the beginning of May to mid-October, the winter season from December to the end of March. In summer, peaks, mountain bike tours and alpine huts attract visitors; in winter, ski slopes, toboggan runs, cross-country ski trails and romantic winter hiking paths. Hiking trails begin in the immediate vicinity of the house; the shortest designated distance is around 50 metres.
